facts.statement: A community event had groups take on Darvon's Descent, a cave dungeon in Sanctuary run by Darvon and his Changling soldiers, on Friday October 16 (3pm-5pm Pacific, U.S. and Latin America) and Monday October 19 (7:30am-9:30am Pacific / 4:30pm-6:30pm GMT, UK and Europe), both on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday October 16th 3pm – 5pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE's community event post announces group runs of the Darvon's Descent dungeon in Sanctuary on two dated schedules for Server 1, one for U.S./Latin America and one for UK/Europe. It describes the dungeon as a difficult battle where higher-level players can group with lower-level ones. The date is inferred from the posted-ago timestamp and the capture date, so it is approximate.
